func Slug(s string) string {
	fields := strings.Fields(s)
	return strings.ToLower(strings.Join(fields, "-"))
}

`JoinSlug(parts ...string) string`:
- Slug each part, skip empty results, join with "/"
- `JoinSlug("Hello World", "Big Day")` → Slug each → "hello-world", "big-day" → "hello-world/big-day"
- `JoinSlug("a", "", "b")` → "a", "", "b" → skip empty → "a/b"

```go
func JoinSlug(parts ...string) string {
	slugs := make([]string, 0, len(parts))
	for _, p := range parts {
		if s := Slug(p); s != "" {
			slugs = append(slugs, s)
		}
	}
	return strings.Join(slugs, "/")
}
```
